description: gpinitsystem_config of a Greenplum-family cluster: primaries only, no standby coordinator.

fields.description: ARRAY_NAME, the display name of the cluster.
fields.name: array_name
fields.title: Array name

fields.description: SEG_PREFIX of the segment data directories (gpseg0, gpseg1, …).
fields.name: seg_prefix
fields.title: Segment prefix

fields.description: PORT_BASE: the first primary segment's port; the next ones count up. Must lie below the kernel's ephemeral port range.
fields.name: port_base
fields.title: Primary port base

fields.description: ENCODING of the template database and of the cluster's databases.
fields.name: encoding
fields.title: Encoding

fields.description: DATABASE_NAME: the database gpinitsystem creates after the cluster is up.
fields.name: database_name
fields.title: Database

fields.description: Spelling of the coordinator keys: MASTER on a PostgreSQL 9.4 base, COORDINATOR on 12 and 14. Filled by the server from the engine version.
fields.name: coordinator_keyword
fields.title: Coordinator keyword

fields.description: COORDINATOR_HOSTNAME: the coordinator's private address. Filled by the server from topology.
fields.name: coordinator_hostname
fields.title: Coordinator address

fields.description: COORDINATOR_DIRECTORY on the coordinator's data volume.
fields.name: coordinator_directory
fields.title: Coordinator directory

fields.description: DATA_DIRECTORY: one entry per primary segment of a segment host; entries may repeat, every segment gets its own gpseg<N> directory inside. Filled by the server from segments_per_host.
fields.name: data_directories
fields.title: Primary directories

fields.description: The `data_directories` list as the bash array gpinitsystem reads.
fields.name: data_directory
fields.title: DATA_DIRECTORY
